label: Certiorari granted
caption: ROBINHOOD MARKETS, INC., ET AL. V. SODHA, VINOD, ET AL.
text: The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted limited to the following question: Whether an issuer can be found liable under the misleading-omissions prong of Section 11(a) of the Securities Act of 1933, 15 U.S.C. 77a et seq., based on a determination that the issuer failed to disclose interim financial information that is material within the meaning of Section 11(a), without an additional inquiry to determine whether the omission rendered any affirmative statement misleading.

label: Certiorari granted
caption: MULLIN, SEC. OF HOMELAND, ET AL. V. REFUGEE AND IMMIGRANT, ET AL.
text: The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted limited to Questions 1 and 2 presented by the petition.
